summary.purpose: Extracts rows from the Guidewire PolicyCenter policy_period table, validates foreign‑key references to policy and job, applies business rule checks, adds ETL metadata, and loads the clean data into the data‑warehouse staging table while quarantining invalid rows and logging execution details.
summary.high_level_narrative: When the package runs it first inserts a start record into etl.etl_audit_log. The Data Flow task then reads all columns from public.policy_period via the source connection. Each row is passed through a Lookup against stg.policy to ensure the policy_id exists; non‑matching rows are sent to an error stream. Matching rows continue to a second Lookup against stg.job to validate job_id, with non‑matches also routed to error. Valid rows receive a derived column etl_load_date (current timestamp). A Conditional Split then evaluates four business rules (expiration_date > effective_date, term_number >= 1, written_date <= current date, period_status in the allowed list). Rows that satisfy all rules are directed to the OLE DB Destination that fast‑loads them into stg.policy_period. All error streams (source errors, lookup no‑matches, and conditional‑split failures) are combined with a Union All component and written to stg.error_quarantine for review. After the data flow completes, an Execute SQL task updates the audit log with end time and row counts. Any package‑level error triggers an OnError handler that records details in etl.etl_error_log.
outputs: stg.policy_period (staging table in the data warehouse)
key_transformations: SELECT policy_period_id, policy_id, job_id, term_number, effective_date, expiration_date, period_status, written_date, transaction_effective_date FROM public.policy_period
Lookup validation of policy_id against stg.policy (referential integrity)
Lookup validation of job_id against stg.job (referential integrity)
Conditional split enforcing: expiration_date > effective_date; term_number >= 1; written_date <= GETDATE(); period_status IN ('ACTIVE','EXPIRED','CANCELLED','ENDED')
Union All of all error/no‑match streams
Fast load (bulk insert) into stg.policy_period with commit size 10,000
Audit log insert at start and update with row counts at end

Execute SQL Tasks for audit logging and error logging
OLE DB Destination components for stg.policy_period and stg.error_quarantine

business_rules: BR‑01 / BR‑05: policy_id must exist in stg.policy (foreign‑key validation)
BR‑01 / BR‑05: job_id must exist in stg.job (foreign‑key validation)
Expiration date must be later than effective date
Term number must be greater than or equal to 1
Written date must not be in the future (<= current date)
Period status must be one of: ACTIVE, EXPIRED, CANCELLED, ENDED

key_logic: Log package start in etl.etl_audit_log (status RUNNING).
Read all columns from public.policy_period via the source component.

Lookup job_id against stg.job; rows without a match are sent to the error path.
Add ETL metadata column etl_load_date (current date).

Apply business rule validation: expiration_date > effective_date, term_number >= 1, written_date <= current date, period_status in ('ACTIVE','EXPIRED','CANCELLED','ENDED'). Valid rows continue, invalid rows go to error path.
Union all error streams (lookup no‑match rows, business rule failures, source read errors) into a single error flow.
Write error flow to stg.error_quarantine.

Log package end in etl.etl_audit_log with end_time, status COMPLETED, and row counts (RowsRead, RowsInserted, RowsRejected).
On any package error, insert a record into etl.etl_error_log.
